goals: Verify the POPULATE function correctly generates various statistical distributions (uniform, normal, Poisson) based on input parameters, while preserving the input 'x' values and output shape.
activities: Create an input vector 'x' containing an array of even numbers from 0 to 98.
Call the POPULATE function with 'x', specifying a uniform distribution between 0 and 1.
Verify that the x-values of the result match the input vector's values.
Verify that all y-values of the result are less than 1.
Verify that all y-values of the result are greater than 0.
